android.desc: SimpleCloudNotifier is an app to display messages that you can send to your phone with simple POST requests. After you start the app it generates a UserID and a UserSecret. Now you can send your message to https://simplecloudnotifier.de/ and a notification will be pushed to your phone. (see https://simplecloudnotifier.de/api for an example with curl) Use it to - send yourself automated messages from cron jobs - notify yourself when long-running scripts finish - send server error messages directly to your phone - integrate with other online services - organize message sinto channels - subscribe to channels of other users The possibilities are endless* *Disclaimer: Developer does not actually guarantee endless possibilities
